estimated_size.method: Extrapolate the observed B+B2 retained/eligible fraction to the 41..60 action band. Scale mean JSONL bytes per retained trajectory by the square of mean acting-call ratio because repeated prefixes dominate serialization. This is an estimate, not conversion or context validation.
limitations: C mapping, pinned root licence text, complete-episode 32768-token admission and action-sequence deduplication were not run.
Longer action sequences may be rejected more often at the same 32k cap; the extrapolated retained count may overestimate yield.
The reported issue/attempt eligibility counts are measured facts; final admitted C counts remain unknown.
The joint three-attempt cap upper bound is aggregate only; per-issue eligibility and conversion success can reduce it.
